approved: Private Health Insurance (Risk Equalisation Levy) Amendment Bill 2015
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill is part of a package that transfers the Council's prudential and regulatory functions for private health insurers to the Australian Prudential Regulation Authority from 1 July 2015.
The package creates a new prudential regulation regime for private health insurers overseen by APRA and makes consequential amendments to related laws.
This bill continues the existing levy on the private health insurance industry to pay for regulatory activities.
The bill provides for the continued imposition of a levy on the private health insurance industry.
The bill is part of a larger package that transfers the Council's functions to APRA.
Private health insurers are affected by the levy.

The Private Health Insurance (Risk Equalisation Levy) Amendment Bill 2015 transfers the functions of setting the risk equalisation levy from the council to APRA, while the health minister retains overall policy responsibility.
Private Health Insurance (Risk Equalisation Levy) Amendment Act 2015
